explication: seekdb is a MySQL-compatible database for embedded and server use, with transactional SQL, hybrid vector/full-text/scalar search, and agent-oriented sandboxing. The main workflow is a client request through the MySQL interface and SQL execution into transactional storage, with log persistence; queries can combine vector and full-text retrieval. README-described asynchronous indexing and copy-on-write fork/merge are included as product capabilities, but their implementation files are not present in the supplied tree, so their placement and connections are documented rather than source-verified. The sampled source confirms SQL plan generation, memtable lookup, log I/O submission, and tablet metadata persistence.
